network_status.network: Bridge collapses in Italy across the 21st century: survey and statistical analysis
network_status.summary_it: Le fonti documentano la piena improvvisa del Verbone, noto anche come Crosia, e la perdita della pila centrale di un ponte a Vallecrosia, ma non pubblicano il livello o la portata. La denominazione alternativa del torrente è conservata senza attribuire un valore di colmo non documentato.
network_status.summary_en: The sources document the flash flood of the Verbone, also known as Crosia, and loss of a central bridge pier at Vallecrosia but publish no stage or discharge. The alternative stream name is retained without inventing a numerical peak.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
